comparison.objective: Candidate rejects open cartons without losing loose contents; PR-1151 removes air from a syringe while preserving liquid and returns the syringe to its rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve loss avoidance, but candidate uses external sidewall grasping and level transport on a moving belt; PR-1151 uses syringe orientation, bubble migration and controlled plunger displacement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades carton routing, rim-crossing spill history, tray placement and untouched closed cartons. PR-1151 grades residual air, liquid loss, rack pose, release and a one-second hold.
comparison.reason: The shared preservation constraint is generic; fluid purging through plunger control is a different tested ability from articulated-carton interception. No material rubric detail is missing.
